title: Ginsenoside Rg1 suppresses urate-induced renal tubular ferroptosis through PPARG-dependent antioxidant signaling.
authors: Wang, Jiajia; Wang, Han; Zhang, Shubo; Jiang, Xinyu; Zhang, Hui; Yong, Wei
one_liner_zh: 研究人参皂苷Rg1通过PPARG信号抑制尿酸盐诱导的肾小管铁死亡，虽含分子对接和MD模拟，但核心是药物-蛋白互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，与TF-DNA课题无关。
abstract: Hyperuricemic nephropathy (HN) is characterized by renal tubular injury, oxidative stress and interstitial remodeling, but the signaling mechanisms linking urate stress to ferroptotic tubular damage remain incompletely defined. Here, we investigated whether Ginsenoside Rg1 protects against hyperuricemia-associated renal injury by modulating PPARG-dependent ferroptosis signaling. In mice challenged with potassium oxonate and hypoxanthine, Rg1 improved renal histopathology and reduced serum uric acid, creatinine, blood urea nitrogen and xanthine oxidase activity. Rg1 also reversed ferroptosis-associated abnormalities in renal tissue, including glutathione depletion, lipid peroxidation, mitochondrial damage, downregulation of GPX4, SLC7A11 and NRF2, and upregulation of ACSL4. Consistently, in uric acid-exposed HK-2 cells, Rg1 preserved cell viability, restored mitochondrial membrane potential and suppressed oxidative and ferroptotic injury. Network pharmacology prioritized PPARG as a candidate target of Rg1, and molecular docking, molecular dynamics simulation and surface plasmon resonance supported a direct Rg1-PPARG interaction, with an equilibrium dissociation constant of 5.37 muM. Rg1 restored PPARG expression under hyperuricemic stress, whereas pharmacological PPARG inhibition with GW9662 or siRNA-mediated PPARG knockdown abolished Rg1-induced activation of the NRF2/SLC7A11/GPX4 axis and its anti-ferroptotic cytoprotection. These findings identify PPARG-dependent antioxidant signaling as a key mediator of urate-induced tubular ferroptosis and suggest that the Rg1-PPARG axis may be therapeutically exploitable in hyperuricemia-associated kidney injury.
abstract_zh: 高尿酸血症肾病（HN）以肾小管损伤、氧化应激和间质重塑为特征，但将尿酸盐应激与铁死亡性肾小管损伤联系起来的信号机制仍未完全阐明。在此，我们研究了人参皂苷Rg1是否通过调节PPARG依赖性铁死亡信号来保护高尿酸血症相关肾损伤。在草酸钾和次黄嘌呤攻击的小鼠中，Rg1改善了肾组织病理学，并降低了血清尿酸、肌酐、血尿素氮和黄嘌呤氧化酶活性。Rg1还逆转了肾组织中与铁死亡相关的异常，包括谷胱甘肽耗竭、脂质过氧化、线粒体损伤、GPX4、SLC7A11和NRF2的下调，以及ACSL4的上调。一致地，在尿酸暴露的HK-2细胞中，Rg1保持了细胞活力，恢复了线粒体膜电位，并抑制了氧化和铁死亡性损伤。网络药理学将PPARG列为Rg1的候选靶点，分子对接、分子动力学模拟和表面等离子体共振支持Rg1与PPARG的直接相互作用，其平衡解离常数为5.37 μM。Rg1在高尿酸应激下恢复了PPARG表达，而使用GW9662进行药理学PPARG抑制或siRNA介导的PPARG敲低则消除了Rg1诱导的NRF2/SLC7A11/GPX4轴激活及其抗铁死亡细胞保护作用。这些发现将PPARG依赖性抗氧化信号确定为尿酸盐诱导的肾小管铁死亡的关键介质，并提示Rg1-PPARG轴在高尿酸血症相关肾损伤中可能具有治疗开发价值。
